name: Bloody Vermin [Critical]
body:
You have become adept at sneaking a taste of the goods before the battle is over…

Prerequisite(s): Stirgi, Improved Critical

Benefit(s): On a critical hit with a natural weapon your blood drain racial ability can trigger.
